Links to Jira issues and queries via interwiki links. * Use {{Jira|key=PROJECT-123}} to link to a specific issue (uses the jira-task interwiki prefix). * Use {{Jira|jql=...}} to link to a Jira filter. When the value is a Jira URL, the view type is detected from the path: ** /timeline → jira-timeline ** /calendar → jira-calendar ** /summary → jira-summary ** /boards → jira-board ** otherwise → jira-jql (plain JQL query) {{#if:{{{key|}}}|[[jira-task:{{{key}}}]]|{{#if:{{#pos:{{{jql|}}}|/timeline}}|[[jira-timeline:{{{jql}}}]]|{{#if:{{#pos:{{{jql|}}}|/calendar}}|[[jira-calendar:{{{jql}}}]]|{{#if:{{#pos:{{{jql|}}}|/summary}}|[[jira-summary:{{{jql}}}]]|{{#if:{{#pos:{{{jql|}}}|/boards}}|[[jira-board:{{{jql}}}]]|[[jira-jql:{{{jql}}}]]}}}}}}}}}}

<noinclude>
Renders an inputbox for creating new pages from a template and lists pages previously created by this macro instance.

Parameters:
* preload - The template page to preload when creating a new page
* buttonlabel - Label for the create button
* macroid - Unique identifier for this macro instance (used to scope created pages)
</noinclude><includeonly>
{{#tag:inputbox|
type=create
preload={{{preload|preload}}}
preloadparams[]={{{macroid|}}}
buttonlabel={{{buttonlabel|Create from template}}}
width=28
break=no
useve=true
}}
{{#ask: [[Created by macro::{{{macroid|}}}]]
| format=embedded
| sort=Creation date
| order=asc
}}
</includeonly>
